The test image shows a corn leaf with:
- Small, round to oval spots scattered randomly across the leaf surface
- Tan/whitish centers with reddish-brown margins
- Yellow halos around some lesions
- Spots distributed randomly (not in bands or along veins)

The reference collage for Holcus_spot confirms the match — particularly the bottom-left panel which nearly mirrors the test image: green field leaf with scattered tan spots having reddish-brown margins, same background soil context.

This pattern is characteristic of **Holcus_spot** (*Pseudomonas syringae pv. syringae*): round/elliptical tan-to-white spots (1/8–1/4 inch) with red-to-brown margins and yellow halos, randomly distributed across the leaf surface.
